name: Thirteenth Goddess
source:
Welcome to the Thirteenth Goddess, an adult fantasy visual novel and adventure and monster-management simulation game about pretty Monster Girls called Taerin — inspired by the unique world of real-life Aotearoa, New Zealand!!


You wash ashore on a world at war... 
Around you, the Twelve Goddesses tear each other apart, and a nameless corruption creeps into the heart of every Taerin, stoking a lust that can't be sated... 

Bond, Cleanse, and Corrupt... 
A nameless corruption lives inside every girl. Bring her home with you, and explore a hundred options to wrestle her mind back from the dark! Teach her what love looks like... or don't! Maybe you like her better as a pink-glowing-eyed abomination?

A thousand different scenes...
A dynamic VN text-based sex system that changes every time you engage with it. Choose how you want every scene to play out. Different personalities, different species, different routes... Your girls will evolve as you do — or more like... as you screw.
translation:
欢迎来到第十三女神，这是一款成人奇幻视觉小说、冒险和怪物管理模拟游戏，讲述了名为Taerin的漂亮怪物女孩 - 灵感来自现实生活中新西兰新西兰Aotearoa的独特世界！


你被冲上岸，身处战火纷飞的世界…… 
在你的周围，十二女神互相撕扯，一种无名的腐败潜入每个泰林的内心，激起无法满足的欲望…… 

债券、净化和腐败…… 
每个女孩的内心都存在着一种无名的腐败。带她回家，探索一百种选择，将她的思绪从黑暗中拉回来！教她什么是爱……或者什么不是！也许你更喜欢她这个粉红眼睛的怪物？

一千个不同的场景…
动态VN基于文本的性系统，每次你参与时都会发生变化。选择你希望每个场景的播放方式。不同的性格、不同的物种、不同的路线……你的女孩会像你一样进化——或者更像……像你一样进化。
